english.note: This is the all-purpose one for cutting or attacking with the teeth, including an animal or insect physically biting.

examples.english: I got a bite from a dog.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 zek3 gau2 ngaau5 can1 laa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for chewing food.

examples.english: You have to chew this meat slowly before you can swallow it.
examples.traditional: 呢啲肉要慢慢咬，先至吞得落。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 juk6 jiu3 maan6 maan6 ngaau5 sin1 zi3 tan1 dak1 lok6
